generic_rules: same_sample is specimen identity, never case identity: a merge between candidates whose own resolved single deposition-target materials differ chemically is BLOCKED, however strong the specimen link; a candidate with no single target (multi-material scope evidence) blocks nothing

case deposition target is resolved by evidence specificity, never by union: members' own target materials decide `deposited_material`; a linked scope's other deposited layers (stack micrograph, multilayer caption) become specimen_context_materials with role and provenance, and only a case documented purely as a multi-material structure keeps a multi-material target

evidence scope follows the statement's position: a same-statement in one panel's caption clause links only that panel's candidates; preamble/body statements are figure-wide; figure citations are read at the source's own precision (Fig. 2b targets panel b)

a panel clause's prose-typed single-value conditions bind to that panel's candidates directly (panel_caption_direct, rank 52); enumerating clauses bind nothing (the sweep's values belong to the series labels); unit-generic numbers bind nothing
caption enumerations license within-figure links only: the caption describes what its own figure shows

quantity-local numeric parsing: a hint phrase that carries its own number (scalar or range) is read from the matched span; tail/head searches never cross a sentence boundary; ranges, approximations and head-positioned values are supported

ontology_target_identity_repair.scope: mandate 4: ontology as the single authority for representation identity and reachability; plus five architecture guarantees (declared-alias-only group collapse, multi-hop rule-graph traversal, policy-gated QuantityKind targets, rule applicability enforcement, member-scoped progression removal)
architecture: pipeline/canonical/comparison_targets.py is the ONE authority: axis meaning -> ComparisonGroup / policy-authorized QuantityKind -> canonical unit spelling -> deterministic ontology display label
workbench-local string target_id(axis|quantity|normalization|dimension|unit) removed; every target id is x|group:<id> or a policy-authorized x|qk:<quantity>|... identity

unit alias spellings (um/µm/μm; '-'/'1'/'dimensionless'; deg/°) fold through the unit registry to ONE canonical spelling; the source spelling is provenance (source_unit_spelling); a value conversion is an explicit formal-rule route (unit_conversion_route), never a silent identity
native_source representations are display/provenance only and never carry an overlay target; overlay identity lives on ontology-resolved representations
the informal ontology `transforms` list is superseded: result_comparability.TRANSFORMS is a derived view of the formal transformation_rules registry

ontology_rule_representations traverses the WHOLE TransformationRule graph breadth-first per axis (cycle-safe, shortest route wins, complete ordered route with per-hop parameters and provenance); one-hop expansion is gone

ComparisonGroups collapse ONLY through the ontology's declared alias_of relation (dose alias_of exposure is now DECLARED); multiple undeclared same-identity groups are refused as ambiguous, never lexicographically merged
QuantityKinds without a ComparisonGroup are direct targets only under the ontology's comparison_policy (declared_axis_roles_only); everything else stays source-native

a rule's confidence_policy is enforced: assumption_recorded rules apply only under their declared applicability evidence (e.g. gpc<->thickness needs nucleation_delay, never cycle count alone); the refusal names the missing evidence
pair verdicts and overlay authorization read ONE reachability in BOTH directions: unreachable ok-level claims are demoted to missing_context with the gap named

progression-condition removal is member/provenance scoped: only assertions stated by the traversing member, or interval-valued sweep statements, move to progression context; a sibling's fixed scalar is never deleted
